metadata.description: Formal security audit findings for checklist items batch 3 - Engine API state machine
metadata.analysis_method: 5-phase attack vector analysis with counterexample construction

input_validation_bypass.finding: Engine API registered with Authenticated: true at api.go:58. Idle state waits for authenticated JWT requests.

state_transition_violation.finding: State transitions from idle only via ForkchoiceUpdated or NewPayload with valid JWT.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Unauthenticated requests rejected by JWT handler, preventing resource exhaustion.

faulty_error_handling.finding: 401 Unauthorized returned for missing/invalid JWT before any state change.

race_conditions.finding: forkchoiceLock and newPayloadLock serialize state transitions.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Idle state protected by authentication requirement; state transitions serialized.

audit_findings.notes: Engine API namespace requires JWT for all operations.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ForkchoiceStateV1 validated - zero hash check, block existence check before processing.

state_transition_violation.finding: CL prepares forkchoice after constructing valid ForkchoiceStateV1 with authenticated JWT.

resource_exhaustion.finding: JWT authentication gate prevents unauthorized forkchoice requests.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Invalid forkchoice state returns STATUS_INVALID before state modification.

race_conditions.finding: forkchoiceLock acquired at entry (api.go:247-248).

guard_evaluation.rationale: Only authenticated CL can trigger forkchoice; state validated before processing.

audit_findings.notes: CL authenticated via JWT before forkchoice processing begins.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ExecutableData validated per version (V1/V2/V3/V4) before processing.

state_transition_violation.finding: CL prepares newPayload after constructing ExecutableData with authenticated JWT.

resource_exhaustion.finding: JWT authentication gate; newPayloadLock prevents concurrent processing.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Invalid payload structure returns INVALID before block execution.

race_conditions.finding: newPayloadLock acquired at entry (api.go:754-755).

guard_evaluation.rationale: Only authenticated CL can trigger newPayload; payload validated before processing.

audit_findings.notes: CL authenticated via JWT before newPayload processing begins.

input_validation_bypass.finding: JWT parsed with HS256 only via jwt.WithValidMethods. No algorithm confusion possible.

state_transition_violation.finding: Invalid JWT returns 401 before any Engine API processing.

resource_exhaustion.finding: JWT validation is O(1); rejected early without heavy computation.

faulty_error_handling.finding: All error paths return 401: missing token, invalid token, expired, stale, future iat.

race_conditions.finding: JWT validation is stateless; no race conditions possible.

guard_evaluation.rationale: JWT validation comprehensive: algorithm, timing, claims all verified.

audit_findings.notes: Follows Engine API JWT authentication specification.

input_validation_bypass.finding: All rejection cases return 401 and terminate via return statement.

state_transition_violation.finding: JWT rejection prevents any Engine API state changes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Rejection is immediate; no resources consumed after rejection.

faulty_error_handling.finding: http.Error returns proper 401 status; no information leakage.

race_conditions.finding: Rejection is synchronous and final.

guards_identified: No fallthrough to handler.next on error
guard_evaluation.rationale: All rejection paths terminate immediately with 401.

audit_findings.notes: No state changes occur on JWT rejection.

input_validation_bypass.finding: forkchoiceUpdated validates head/finalized/safe hashes before state updates.

state_transition_violation.finding: SetCanonical, SetFinalized, SetSafe only called after validation passes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: forkchoiceLock prevents concurrent forkchoice processing.

faulty_error_handling.finding: STATUS_INVALID returned for invalid state; STATUS_SYNCING for missing blocks.

race_conditions.finding: forkchoiceLock.Lock() at entry serializes all forkchoice operations.

guard_evaluation.rationale: All forkchoice state changes validated and serialized.

audit_findings.notes: Only reachable via authenticated Engine API.

input_validation_bypass.finding: GetBlockByHash at line 261 returns nil for non-existent blocks.

state_transition_violation.finding: Missing blocks trigger SYNCING status, not state modification.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Database lookup is O(1) hash lookup, bounded resource usage.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Nil block properly handled with BeaconSync trigger.

race_conditions.finding: Block lookup under forkchoiceLock; consistent view guaranteed.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Block existence properly validated before any head update.

audit_findings.notes: Block must exist locally before head can be set.

input_validation_bypass.finding: SYNCING status returned when required blocks/state not available locally.

state_transition_violation.finding: No state modifications occur in SYNCING state; sync triggered externally.

resource_exhaustion.finding: BeaconSync initiated to retrieve missing data; bounded by sync protocol.

faulty_error_handling.finding: SYNCING properly returned at lines 277, 297, 299 for various missing data scenarios.

race_conditions.finding: Sync state tracked atomically; forkchoiceLock prevents concurrent updates.

guard_evaluation.rationale: SYNCING state properly indicates EL is fetching required data.

audit_findings.notes: Sync protocol handles missing block retrieval.

input_validation_bypass.finding: SetCanonical only called after GetBlockByHash confirms block exists (line 261).

state_transition_violation.finding: Canonical head only updated for validated, existing blocks.

resource_exhaustion.finding: SetCanonical bounded by chain reorg depth; chainmu protects database.

faulty_error_handling.finding: SetCanonical errors return INVALID with latestValidHash for recovery.

race_conditions.finding: forkchoiceLock + chainmu provide serialization.

guards_identified: Difficulty check prevents post-TTD PoW blocks
guard_evaluation.rationale: Canonical head only set for validated, existing blocks.

audit_findings.notes: Canonical chain update atomic via chainmu.

input_validation_bypass.finding: Finalized/safe blocks verified to exist and be in canonical chain before update.

state_transition_violation.finding: SetFinalized/SetSafe only called after block validation passes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Finalized/safe updates are O(1) pointer updates.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Invalid finalized/safe returns STATUS_INVALID with InvalidForkChoiceState error.

race_conditions.finding: Updates under forkchoiceLock; atomic pointer stores.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Finalized and safe blocks must exist in canonical chain.

audit_findings.notes: Finalized block is permanent; cannot be reorged.

input_validation_bypass.finding: PayloadAttributes validated per version before BuildPayload call.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload building only starts after successful forkchoice processing.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Payload building bounded by block gas limit and transaction pool.

faulty_error_handling.finding: BuildPayload errors return valid(nil) with InvalidPayloadAttributes.

race_conditions.finding: localBlocks.has() check and put() serialized by forkchoiceLock.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Payload building only after valid forkchoice and attributes.

audit_findings.notes: PayloadID returned for later GetPayload retrieval.

input_validation_bypass.finding: BuildPayload uses txpool.Pending() - only validated transactions included.

state_transition_violation.finding: Payload building operates on validated transaction pool state.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block gas limit and transaction count bound payload size.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Transaction execution failures during building handled gracefully.

race_conditions.finding: Payload building has internal synchronization for transaction selection.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Only pool-validated transactions considered for inclusion.

audit_findings.notes: Transactions double-validated: pool entry and block execution.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ForkChoiceResponse constructed only after all validations pass.

state_transition_violation.finding: valid() helper sets VALID status with correct LatestValidHash.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Response construction is O(1), minimal resource usage.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Proper status (VALID/INVALID/SYNCING) returned based on processing outcome.

race_conditions.finding: Response constructed under forkchoiceLock.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Response accurately reflects forkchoice processing outcome.

audit_findings.notes: Engine API spec compliant response structure.

input_validation_bypass.finding: newPayload validates structure via ExecutableDataToBlock before execution.

state_transition_violation.finding: InsertBlockWithoutSetHead stores block without updating canonical head.

resource_exhaustion.finding: newPayloadLock serializes processing; block gas limits bound execution.

faulty_error_handling.finding: api.invalid() returns proper status with latestValidHash for chain recovery.

race_conditions.finding: newPayloadLock acquired at entry (line 754-755).

guard_evaluation.rationale: Payload processing serialized and validated.

audit_findings.notes: Only reachable via authenticated Engine API.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ExecutableDataToBlock at line 758 validates all structural fields.

state_transition_violation.finding: Malformed payloads rejected before any state changes.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Structural validation is O(n) in transactions, bounded by block gas.

faulty_error_handling.finding: api.invalid(err, nil) at line 788 returns INVALID for structure errors.

race_conditions.finding: Validation under newPayloadLock.

guard_evaluation.rationale: All payload fields validated before block construction.

audit_findings.notes: Block hash must match computed hash from payload.

input_validation_bypass.finding: api.invalid() constructs proper INVALID response without state modification.

state_transition_violation.finding: Structure errors return early; no state changes occur.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Early rejection prevents expensive execution.

faulty_error_handling.finding: INVALID status with nil latestValidHash for structure errors.

race_conditions.finding: Error return is immediate and synchronous.

guards_identified: api.invalid() helper for consistent error response
guard_evaluation.rationale: Invalid structure immediately rejected with proper status.

audit_findings.notes: No state modification on structure validation failure.

input_validation_bypass.finding: ExecutableDataToBlock verifies computed block hash matches declared hash.

state_transition_violation.finding: Conversion creates Block object without modifying chain state.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block construction bounded by transaction count and payload size.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Conversion errors (hash mismatch, invalid tx) properly returned.

race_conditions.finding: Block construction is pure function, no shared state.

guards_identified: Block hash verification against declared BlockHash
guard_evaluation.rationale: Block hash cryptographically commits to all block contents.

audit_findings.notes: Block hash mismatch returns INVALID_BLOCK_HASH.

input_validation_bypass.finding: InsertBlockWithoutSetHead stores block but doesn't set as canonical head.

state_transition_violation.finding: Block stored for later forkchoice, not immediately canonical.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Block storage bounded; invalid blocks tracked with eviction limit (128).

faulty_error_handling.finding: Insertion errors tracked in invalidBlocksHits and invalidTipsets.

race_conditions.finding: newPayloadLock serializes insertions; chainmu protects database.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Block storage separate from canonical head update.

audit_findings.notes: Canonical head only updated via ForkchoiceUpdated.

input_validation_bypass.finding: InsertBlockWithoutSetHead executes all transactions via insertChain.

state_transition_violation.finding: State root validated against header after execution.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Execution bounded by block gas limit; gas metering enforced.

faulty_error_handling.finding: Execution errors return INVALID with parent as latestValidHash.

race_conditions.finding: Block processing serialized by newPayloadLock and chainmu.

guard_evaluation.rationale: Full block execution with state validation.

audit_findings.notes: State root mismatch causes block rejection.

input_validation_bypass.finding: VALID returned only after successful InsertBlockWithoutSetHead.

state_transition_violation.finding: Block stored with validated state; ready for forkchoice.

resource_exhaustion.finding: Valid block storage is necessary for chain operation.

faulty_error_handling.finding: VALID status with block hash as LatestValidHash.

race_conditions.finding: Status returned under newPayloadLock.

guard_evaluation.rationale: VALID only after comprehensive block validation.

audit_findings.notes: Valid blocks cached for subsequent forkchoice.
